title: ClearPath Client Relief on Restart Re-Pricing — Professional Services Projects
content:
ClearPath Managed IT Services clients on the upper tiers carry fewer points on the restart re-pricing of a held Professional Services Projects engagement.

For a client whose ClearPath agreement in active status is on the ClearPath Professional, Premier or Enterprise tier and covers 100 or more seats, 2.0 points are taken off the restart re-pricing; for a client on one of those tiers covering fewer than 100 seats, 1.0 point; for any other client none.

| Active ClearPath agreement on Professional, Premier or Enterprise? | Seats covered | Points taken off the restart re-pricing |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 100 or more | 2.0 |
| Yes | fewer than 100 | 1.0 |
| No | any | none |

Hypothetical illustration: a ClearPath Premier client in active status with 99 seats has 1.0 point taken off; with 100 seats, 2.0 points; a ClearPath Standard client with 300 seats, none.
